ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Exposed: A Deeper Dive into Feeding Our Future and Housing Stabilization Schemes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the Feeding Our Future and Housing Stabilization schemes.
questions: What is the scope of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it could uncover a larger pattern of fraud in Minnesota and potentially lead to the recovery of millions of dollars in lost funds.
